selected_t21_target.root_cause: buildTapDrillBlock() copies hp.source_dataset/source_record/source_field verbatim into tap_drill.provenance.{source_dataset,source_record,source_field}. Check 15 (T19) uses these copied fields as a lookup key to prove internal projection consistency (value matches what the pointer, taken at face value, resolves to) but never compares the pointer itself to the tapping dataset's current, authoritative hole_preparation.* fields.
affected_consumers: js/tapping-workflow-data.js (embedded, not separately rendered by Workflow's own UI)
selected_t21_target.existing_coverage: existence-only (check 2, source_dataset); non-emptiness (check 3, all three); dereferenced-but-not-source-compared (check 15)
selected_t21_target.exact_missing_invariant: For every profile row, row.tap_drill.provenance.source_dataset must equal sourceRecord.hole_preparation.source_dataset (likewise source_record, source_field), where sourceRecord is the authoritative tapping-dataset record for that tapping_profile_id.
selected_t21_target.why_t13_t20_do_not_cover_it: T13/T14 derive the OTHER two fields of the same provenance object (source, cross_check) from hp.cross_verified. T15-T18, T20 cover entirely different field families. T19 proves internal projection consistency (pointer -> dereferenced value), a distinct invariant from source-vs-projection citation freshness, demonstrated concretely with a mutation T19's own check cannot catch.

implementation_contract.validator_behavior_required: Add check 17: for each profile row, look up the source tapping-dataset record by tapping_profile_id (reuse the existing sourceRecordById map from checks 10/11/13/16), compare sourceRecord.hole_preparation.source_dataset/.source_record/.source_field individually against row.tap_drill.provenance.source_dataset/.source_record/.source_field, fail on any mismatch naming profile, field, projected value, authoritative value.
implementation_contract.pass_criteria: 0 errors on real data (confirmed by direct inspection); correct failure on a reproduced source-citation mutation; all other 16 checks and every other validator unaffected.

mutation_test_contract: Temporarily change hole_preparation.source_field (or source_record) on one real tapping-dataset record (e.g. tap_m3x0_5_cut in metric_tapping.seed.json), backed up first, without regenerating the projection. Before the fix: full 16-check suite still reports PASS (demonstrates the gap). After the fix: check 17 reports FAIL naming that profile, field, stale value, new authoritative value. Restore from backup, confirm byte-identical checksum, confirm PASS. Run validator 3x on restored data for determinism.
